translations.kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
translations.ylt: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of the choice ones of God, and an acknowledging of truth that is according to piety,
translations.web: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

translations.kjv: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
translations.ylt: upon hope of life age-during, which God, who doth not lie, did promise before times of ages,
translations.web: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

translations.kjv: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
translations.ylt: (and He manifested in proper times His word,) in preaching, which I was entrusted with, according to a charge of God our Saviour,
translations.web: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

translations.kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
translations.ylt: to Titus--true child according to a common faith: Grace, kindness, peace, from God the Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour!
translations.web: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

translations.kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
translations.ylt: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that the things lacking thou mayest arrange, and mayest set down in every city elders, as I did appoint to thee;
translations.web: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

translations.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
translations.ylt: if any one is blameless, of one wife a husband, having children stedfast, not under accusation of riotous living or insubordinate--
translations.web: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

translations.kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
translations.ylt: for it behoveth the overseer to be blameless, as God's steward, not self-pleased, nor irascible, not given to wine, not a striker, not given to filthy lucre;
translations.web: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

translations.kjv: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
translations.ylt: but a lover of strangers, a lover of good men, sober-minded, righteous, kind, self-controlled,
translations.web: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

translations.kjv: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
translations.ylt: holding--according to the teaching--to the stedfast word, that he may be able also to exhort in the sound teaching, and the gainsayers to convict;
translations.web: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

translations.kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
translations.ylt: for there are many both insubordinate, vain-talkers, and mind-deceivers--especially they of the circumcision--
translations.web: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

translations.kjv: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.
translations.ylt: whose mouth it behoveth to stop, who whole households do overturn, teaching what things it behoveth not, for filthy lucre's sake.
translations.web: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

translations.kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
translations.ylt: A certain one of them, a prophet of their own, said--`Cretans! always liars, evil beasts, lazy bellies!'
translations.web: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

translations.kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
translations.ylt: this testimony is true; for which cause convict them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
translations.web: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

translations.kjv: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
translations.ylt: not giving heed to Jewish fables and commands of men, turning themselves away from the truth;
translations.web: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

translations.kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
translations.ylt: all things, indeed, are pure to the pure, and to the defiled and unstedfast is nothing pure, but of them defiled are even the mind and the conscience;
translations.web: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

translations.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
translations.ylt: God they profess to know, and in the works they deny Him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work disapproved.
translations.web: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

translations.kjv: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
translations.ylt: And thou--be speaking what doth become the sound teaching;
translations.web: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

translations.kjv: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
translations.ylt: aged men to be temperate, grave, sober, sound in the faith, in the love, in the endurance;
translations.web: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

translations.kjv: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
translations.ylt: aged women, in like manner, in deportment as doth become sacred persons, not false accusers, to much wine not enslaved, of good things teachers,
translations.web: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

translations.kjv: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
translations.ylt: that they may make the young women sober-minded, to be lovers of their husbands, lovers of their children,
translations.web: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

translations.kjv: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
translations.ylt: sober, pure, keepers of their own houses, good, subject to their own husbands, that the word of God may not be evil spoken of.
translations.web: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

translations.kjv: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
translations.ylt: The younger men, in like manner, be exhorting to be sober-minded;
translations.web: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

translations.kjv: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
translations.ylt: concerning all things thyself showing a pattern of good works; in the teaching uncorruptedness, gravity, incorruptibility,
translations.web: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

translations.kjv: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
translations.ylt: discourse sound, irreprehensible, that he who is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having nothing evil to say concerning you.
translations.web: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

translations.kjv: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
translations.ylt: Servants--to their own masters are to be subject, in all things to be well-pleasing, not gainsaying,
translations.web: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

translations.kjv: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
translations.ylt: not purloining, but showing all good stedfastness, that the teaching of God our Saviour they may adorn in all things.
translations.web: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

translations.kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
translations.ylt: For the saving grace of God was manifested to all men,
translations.web: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

translations.kjv: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
translations.ylt: teaching us, that denying the impiety and the worldly desires, soberly and righteously and piously we may live in the present age,
translations.web: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

translations.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
translations.ylt: waiting for the blessed hope and manifestation of the glory of our great God and Saviour Jesus Christ,
translations.web: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

translations.kjv: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
translations.ylt: who did give himself for us, that he might ransom us from all lawlessness, and might purify to himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works;
translations.web: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

translations.kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
translations.ylt: these things be speaking, and exhorting, and convicting, with all charge; let no one despise thee!
translations.web: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

translations.kjv: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
translations.ylt: Remind them to be subject to principalities and authorities, to obey rule, unto every good work to be ready,
translations.web: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

translations.kjv: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
translations.ylt: of no one to speak evil, not to be quarrelsome--gentle, showing all meekness to all men,
translations.web: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

translations.kjv: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
translations.ylt: for we were once--also we--thoughtless, disobedient, led astray, serving desires and pleasures manifold, in malice and envy living, odious--hating one another;
translations.web: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

translations.kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
translations.ylt: and when the kindness and the love to men of God our Saviour did appear
translations.web: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

translations.kjv: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
translations.ylt: (not by works that are in righteousness that we did but according to His kindness,) He did save us, through a bathing of regeneration, and a renewing of the Holy Spirit,
translations.web: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

translations.kjv: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
translations.ylt: which He poured upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour,
translations.web: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

translations.kjv: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
translations.ylt: that having been declared righteous by His grace, heirs we may become according to the hope of life age-during.
translations.web: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

translations.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
translations.ylt: Stedfast is the word; and concerning these things I counsel thee to affirm fully, that they may be thoughtful, to be leading in good works--who have believed God; these are the good and profitable things to men,
translations.web: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

translations.kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
translations.ylt: and foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about law, stand away from--for they are unprofitable and vain.
translations.web: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

translations.kjv: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
translations.ylt: A sectarian man, after a first and second admonition be rejecting,
translations.web: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

translations.kjv: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
translations.ylt: having known that he hath been subverted who is such, and doth sin, being self-condemned.
translations.web: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

translations.kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
translations.ylt: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis, for there to winter I have determined.
translations.web: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

translations.kjv: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
translations.ylt: Zenas the lawyer and Apollos bring diligently on their way, that nothing to them may be lacking,
translations.web: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

translations.kjv: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
translations.ylt: and let them learn--ours also--to be leading in good works to the necessary uses, that they may not be unfruitful.
translations.web: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

translations.kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen. It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.
translations.ylt: Salute thee do all those with me; salute those loving us in faith; the grace is with you all!
translations.web: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
